```mermaid
flowchart LR
    %% title: Start a return 2
    %% subtitle: How a Fernhouse customer starts a return in the app, from the order list to a confirmed return
    %% source: Sources: five app screens and the returns doc, as described, with the 30 day exit updated to Request an exception. Left out: free pickup over €100, a proposal under review, and any screen after Request an exception.
    %% zone: Find the order: orders, detail
    %% zone: Request the return: window, support, reason, method
    %% zone: Done: confirmed
    orders([Order list]) --> detail[Order detail]
    detail --> window{Within 30 days?}
    window -->|No| support([Request an exception])
    window -->|Yes| reason[Pick a reason]
    reason --> method{Drop-off or pickup?}
    method -->|Drop-off| confirmed([Return confirmed])
    method -->|Pickup| confirmed
    style confirmed fill:#CDF4D3,stroke:#66D575
```
EOF
python3 sk-create-figjam/scripts/flow_check.py "$S/model.md" && python3 sk-create-figjam/scripts/compose_board.py "$S/model.md" --diagram 1 --out "$S/board.js"; echo "exit $?"
